{{image | name=eng-unloaded.jpg | style=128 }}

{{css_skillbox |black| UNLOADED STATE }}
{{activation}}
* The Trooper or game element ("Trooper" from now on) has entirely depleted the ammunition of a weapon or a piece of Equipment either with the [[Disposable]] Trait.

{{effects}}
* The Trooper can no longer use the relevant weapon or piece of Equipment.

{{cancellation}}
{{update | PDF 5.3, September 2026}}
* The Trooper performs the [[Reload]] Common Skill, which does not require a Roll, while inside the [[Zone of Control]] of an [[Allied]] Trooper {{erratahighlight}}or game element with the [[Baggage]] piece of Equipment, and{{erratahighlight-end}} in a non-[[Null]] State.
* In the [[States Phase]], the Trooper is inside the Zone of Control of an Allied Trooper {{erratahighlight}}or game element with the Baggage piece of Equipment, and{{erratahighlight-end}} in a non-Null State.
{{update-end}}
{{original}}
* The Trooper performs the [[Reload]] Common Skill, which does not require a Roll, while inside the [[Zone of Control]] of an [[Allied]] Trooper {{originalhighlight}}with the [[Baggage]] piece of Equipment. The Trooper with Baggage must be{{originalhighlight-end}} in a non-[[Null]] State.
* In the [[States Phase]], the Trooper is inside the Zone of Control of an Allied Trooper with the Baggage piece of Equipment. The Trooper {{originalhighlight}}with Baggage must be{{originalhighlight-end}} in a non-Null State.
{{original-end}}
* Some scenarios and missions have Scenario Special Rules that allow cancellation of this state. In this case, the player must meet the conditions specified by those rules.
* Canceling this state returns all weapons and pieces of Equipment with the [[Disposable]] Trait that the trooper possesses to their full capacity.
{{update | PDF 5.2, October 2025}}
* {{erratahighlight}}'''Restriction:''' Weapons and pieces of Equipment with the [[Non-Reloadable]] Trait cannot cancel this state, unless a scenario or special rule says otherwise.{{erratahighlight-end}}
{{update-end}}
{{css_skillbox-end}}
